Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I3 for Mitsubishi frame 2 Steam Turbine Generator 
carbon brushes, which must be performed every six months or during outage as 
indicated by M6 in the 
title block
Technical Specifications:
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wageh Khalil, revised by MDEPC quality 
control eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran and approved by 
eng. 
Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC 
 quality control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohammed Nageb quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety fence around the work 
 place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes measuring tool.
Blower.
Screw driver.
Work to be 
carried out
Check slip ring's condition
Measure the insulation resistance
Clean around the slip ring
Measure the peep dimension of brush
